displayName: siamSquare พจนานุกรมไทย คลังคำ
description:
siamSquare enhances Thai writing and study in NVDA with built-in dictionary tools for instant definitions, smart spelling corrections, and detailed letter spelling. It includes a full dictionary editor, a Thai alphabet order lookup, and an interactive quiz game to boost learning efficiency.

Hot Keys:
CTRL+F1 : Open Layer Keys
F1 : word meaning
F2 : Misspelled words and similar words
F3 : Spell words
F4 : Open Siam Center Dictionary
F5 : a character-order quiz
